meta.name: Power Rangers Zeo
meta.description: Tommy, Billy, Adam, Rocky, Kat and Tanya are turned back to their teenage forms thanks to the Zeo Crystal. The Command Center is gone but the crystal leads them to the new Power Chamber and all but Billy take on new Zeo powers.

videos.name: A Zeo Beginning (1)
videos.overview: In the rubble of the destroyed Command Center, the Power Rangers find the Zeo Crystal.
videos.description: In the rubble of the destroyed Command Center, the Power Rangers find the Zeo Crystal.

videos.name: A Zeo Beginning (2)
videos.overview: The Rangers face their greatest challenge as Zordon explains that King Mondo is preparing to invade the Solar System, his final link in a chain of galaxies he already controls.
videos.description: The Rangers face their greatest challenge as Zordon explains that King Mondo is preparing to invade the Solar System, his final link in a chain of galaxies he already controls.

videos.name: The Shooting Star
videos.overview: When Mondo and Machina unleash the Staroid on the Zeo Rangers, they are forced to call on their untested Zeo Zords.
videos.description: When Mondo and Machina unleash the Staroid on the Zeo Rangers, they are forced to call on their untested Zeo Zords.

videos.name: Target Rangers
videos.overview: The computer software that Rocky, and his new friend Jennifer are working on, is stolen by the Cogs and used against the Rangers.
videos.description: The computer software that Rocky, and his new friend Jennifer are working on, is stolen by the Cogs and used against the Rangers.

videos.name: For Cryin' Out Loud
videos.overview: Tommy and Katherine take care of a baby for a school assignment giving King Mondo an idea for his evil ambitions.
videos.description: Tommy and Katherine take care of a baby for a school assignment giving King Mondo an idea for his evil ambitions.

videos.name: Rangers in the Outfield
videos.overview: The teens' baseball team provides the perfect outlet for Prince Sprocket to do battle with the Rangers when he turns their batting machine into the People Pitcher.
videos.description: The teens' baseball team provides the perfect outlet for Prince Sprocket to do battle with the Rangers when he turns their batting machine into the People Pitcher.

videos.name: Every Dog Has His Day
videos.overview: Smokey, a specially trained dog, aids the Zeo Rangers in fighting Digster, Mondo and Machina's latest monster.
videos.description: Smokey, a specially trained dog, aids the Zeo Rangers in fighting Digster, Mondo and Machina's latest monster.

videos.name: The Puppet Blaster
videos.overview: When Ernie brings a puppet show to the Youth Center to entertain the children of Angel Grove, Mondo and Machina hatch a plan to control the children's minds, by planting a transmitter on the Puppet Man.
videos.description: When Ernie brings a puppet show to the Youth Center to entertain the children of Angel Grove, Mondo and Machina hatch a plan to control the children's minds, by planting a transmitter on the Puppet Man.

videos.name: Invasion of the Ranger Snatchers
videos.overview: Prince Sprocket recruits the Rangers to be in his own twisted movie; "Invasion of the Ranger Snatchers."
videos.description: Prince Sprocket recruits the Rangers to be in his own twisted movie; "Invasion of the Ranger Snatchers."

videos.name: Graduation Blues
videos.overview: As Billy learns he has accumulated enough credits to graduate from Angel Grove High, Cestro, the Blue Alien Ranger, lands on Earth seeking Billy's help.
videos.description: As Billy learns he has accumulated enough credits to graduate from Angel Grove High, Cestro, the Blue Alien Ranger, lands on Earth seeking Billy's help.

videos.name: A Few Bad Seeds
videos.overview: As Rocky and Adam work on developing hybrid plants for Botany class, Rocky's plant exhibits weird behavior, growing rapidly and developing an appetite for metal.
videos.description: As Rocky and Adam work on developing hybrid plants for Botany class, Rocky's plant exhibits weird behavior, growing rapidly and developing an appetite for metal.

videos.name: Instrument of Destruction
videos.overview: A mysterious musician in Angel Grove High is pursued by Prince Sprocket and King Mondo.
videos.description: A mysterious musician in Angel Grove High is pursued by Prince Sprocket and King Mondo.

videos.name: Mean Screen
videos.overview: Tanya and Adam are exploring the new world of cyberspace with the help of Raymond, a computer whiz, at school. When they run into a computer virus, Mondo gets the idea to create Mean Screen, a horrible computer monster that will infect all of the computers in Angel Grove.
videos.description: Tanya and Adam are exploring the new world of cyberspace with the help of Raymond, a computer whiz, at school. When they run into a computer virus, Mondo gets the idea to create Mean Screen, a horrible computer monster that will infect all of the computers in Angel Grove.

videos.name: Mr. Billy's Wild Ride
videos.overview: As Billy is returning from Aquitar in a space capsule, Machina and Mondo attack his space craft, sending it into the gravitational pull of the Machine Skybase.
videos.description: As Billy is returning from Aquitar in a space capsule, Machina and Mondo attack his space craft, sending it into the gravitational pull of the Machine Skybase.

videos.name: There's No Business Like Snow Business (1)
videos.overview: Tommy receives a "Dear John" letter.
videos.description: Tommy receives a "Dear John" letter.

videos.name: There's No Business Like Snow Business (2)
videos.overview: Mondo and Machina send the Defoliator to create a greenhouse effect in Angel Grove.
videos.description: Mondo and Machina send the Defoliator to create a greenhouse effect in Angel Grove.

videos.name: There's No Business Like Snow Business (3)
videos.overview: As Katherine tries to console Tommy about his "Dear John" letter from Kimberly, a spark of attraction begins to form between the two Rangers.
videos.description: As Katherine tries to console Tommy about his "Dear John" letter from Kimberly, a spark of attraction begins to form between the two Rangers.

videos.name: Inner Spirit
videos.overview: On a journey to find True of Heart, Tommy comes upon the incredible discovery of a young man who looks just like him.
videos.description: On a journey to find True of Heart, Tommy comes upon the incredible discovery of a young man who looks just like him.

videos.name: Challenges
videos.overview: Searching for the other half of an arrowhead, Tommy discovers its owner is his brother.
videos.description: Searching for the other half of an arrowhead, Tommy discovers its owner is his brother.

videos.name: Found and Lost
videos.overview: Having kidnapped Tommy's newfound brother David, King Mondo blackmails Tommy into giving up his half of the arrowhead, in order to set David free.
videos.description: Having kidnapped Tommy's newfound brother David, King Mondo blackmails Tommy into giving up his half of the arrowhead, in order to set David free.

videos.name: Brother, Can You Spare an Arrowhead?
videos.overview: Now that he has both halves of the arrowhead, King Mondo vows to destroy the Zeo Rangers, while continuing to refuse the release of Tommy's brother.
videos.description: Now that he has both halves of the arrowhead, King Mondo vows to destroy the Zeo Rangers, while continuing to refuse the release of Tommy's brother.

videos.name: Trust in Me
videos.overview: King Mondo sends down the Defector robot to trick the Zeo Rangers into gaining their trust, and thereby able to destroy them.
videos.description: King Mondo sends down the Defector robot to trick the Zeo Rangers into gaining their trust, and thereby able to destroy them.

videos.name: It Came from Angel Grove
videos.overview: Adam experiences a nightmarish scenario when the Machine Empire invades Earth overnight and transforms many of Adam's friends into sinister scientists, werewolves, and dark forces.
videos.description: Adam experiences a nightmarish scenario when the Machine Empire invades Earth overnight and transforms many of Adam's friends into sinister scientists, werewolves, and dark forces.

videos.name: Bulk Fiction
videos.overview: Bulk's infatuation with the daughter of a high ranking officer soon puts both his, Skull's, and Lt. Stone's careers in jeopardy.
videos.description: Bulk's infatuation with the daughter of a high ranking officer soon puts both his, Skull's, and Lt. Stone's careers in jeopardy.

videos.name: Song Sung Yellow
videos.overview: Tanya's potential new singing career divides her time between fulfilling an ambition and serving as a Ranger
videos.description: Tanya's potential new singing career divides her time between fulfilling an ambition and serving as a Ranger

videos.name: Game of Honor
videos.overview: King Mondo attempts to rule the Earth's waterways by building a fleet of ships under an invisible field.
videos.description: King Mondo attempts to rule the Earth's waterways by building a fleet of ships under an invisible field.

videos.name: The Power of Gold
videos.overview: King Mondo's plan to divide and conquer the Zeo Rangers is spoiled by the appearance of the Gold Ranger.
videos.description: King Mondo's plan to divide and conquer the Zeo Rangers is spoiled by the appearance of the Gold Ranger.

videos.name: A Small Problem
videos.overview: The other Rangers must find a way to help their friends when Prince Sprocket shrinks Tommy and Katherine and places them in a terrarium with a hungry spider.
videos.description: The other Rangers must find a way to help their friends when Prince Sprocket shrinks Tommy and Katherine and places them in a terrarium with a hungry spider.

videos.name: Oily to Bed, Oily to Rise
videos.overview: Katherine competes in a surfing competition, but faces danger when the Leaky Faucet monster puts toxic Cog oil in all the water in Angel Grove.
videos.description: Katherine competes in a surfing competition, but faces danger when the Leaky Faucet monster puts toxic Cog oil in all the water in Angel Grove.

videos.name: Rock-a-Bye Power Rangers
videos.overview: The Somnibot casts a sleeping spell on the people of Angel Grove, leaving it to the Gold Ranger to break the spell.
videos.description: The Somnibot casts a sleeping spell on the people of Angel Grove, leaving it to the Gold Ranger to break the spell.

videos.name: Do I Know You?
videos.overview: The Gold Ranger finds asylum in the Power Chamber from the evil Mondo, Machina, and the Varox bounty hunter.
videos.description: The Gold Ranger finds asylum in the Power Chamber from the evil Mondo, Machina, and the Varox bounty hunter.

videos.name: Revelations of Gold
videos.overview: When the Gold Ranger is attacked by Varox Bounty Hunters, Pyramidas is hit, and falls into the seas of the planet Aquitar.
videos.description: When the Gold Ranger is attacked by Varox Bounty Hunters, Pyramidas is hit, and falls into the seas of the planet Aquitar.

videos.name: A Golden Homecoming
videos.overview: Time is running out for transference of the Golden Powers.
videos.description: Time is running out for transference of the Golden Powers.

videos.name: Mondo's Last Stand
videos.overview: King Mondo is determined to use the Damocles Sword to destroy the Zeo Rangers.
videos.description: King Mondo is determined to use the Damocles Sword to destroy the Zeo Rangers.

videos.name: Bomber in the Summer
videos.overview: The teens are helping Ernie set up for his new Beach Club when a group of tough teens ride in and begin to trash the place.
videos.description: The teens are helping Ernie set up for his new Beach Club when a group of tough teens ride in and begin to trash the place.

videos.name: Scent of a Weasel
videos.overview: The teens are involved in a charity fashion show for the famous designer, Mr. Stenchy.
videos.description: The teens are involved in a charity fashion show for the famous designer, Mr. Stenchy.

videos.name: The Lore of Auric
videos.overview: Aisha sends Tanya a map of Mysterio Island, the island on which Tanya suspects her parents have been missing for years.
videos.description: Aisha sends Tanya a map of Mysterio Island, the island on which Tanya suspects her parents have been missing for years.

videos.name: The Ranger Who Came in from the Gold
videos.overview: When Katherine stages a ballet about King Midas, Louie Kaboom creates the Midas Hound, an idol that changes everything into gold.
videos.description: When Katherine stages a ballet about King Midas, Louie Kaboom creates the Midas Hound, an idol that changes everything into gold.

videos.name: The Joke's on Blue
videos.overview: A practical joker wrecks havoc on Angel Grove High. While Bulk and Skull try to track down the trickster, Prince Sprocket's brother, Prince Gasket and sister-in-law, Archerina, arrive with a few new tricks of their own!
videos.description: A practical joker wrecks havoc on Angel Grove High. While Bulk and Skull try to track down the trickster, Prince Sprocket's brother, Prince Gasket and sister-in-law, Archerina, arrive with a few new tricks of their own!

videos.name: Where In The World is Zeo Ranger 5?
videos.overview: While jet skiing on the lake, Tommy is mysteriously disappears.
videos.description: While jet skiing on the lake, Tommy is mysteriously disappears.

videos.name: King for a Day (1)
videos.overview: The Zeo Rangers discover that Tommy has been captured by Prince Gasket, and placed in a large arena with monsters battling one another.
videos.description: The Zeo Rangers discover that Tommy has been captured by Prince Gasket, and placed in a large arena with monsters battling one another.

videos.name: King for a Day (2)
videos.overview: The Gold Ranger is forced to defend himself when the brainwashed Tommy attacks him.
videos.description: The Gold Ranger is forced to defend himself when the brainwashed Tommy attacks him.

videos.name: A Brief Mystery of Time
videos.overview: Tommy is confused when he keeps reliving experiences of the day over and over.
videos.description: Tommy is confused when he keeps reliving experiences of the day over and over.

videos.name: A Mystery to Me
videos.overview: The teens all dress in classic mystery character costumes when they participate in a charity dinner organized by Detective Stone.
videos.description: The teens all dress in classic mystery character costumes when they participate in a charity dinner organized by Detective Stone.

videos.name: Another Song and Dance
videos.overview: Tommy asks Tanya for voice lessons when he has to sing in front of the class.
videos.description: Tommy asks Tanya for voice lessons when he has to sing in front of the class.

videos.name: Rangers of Two Worlds (1)
videos.overview: Everyone is stunned when it is revealed that Billy has aged into an old man.
videos.description: Everyone is stunned when it is revealed that Billy has aged into an old man.

videos.name: Rangers of Two Worlds (2)
videos.overview: The Power Rangers Zeo team up with the Alien Rangers of Aquitar to combat a double threat from King Mondo and Lord Zedd.
videos.description: The Power Rangers Zeo team up with the Alien Rangers of Aquitar to combat a double threat from King Mondo and Lord Zedd.

videos.name: Hawaii Zeo
videos.overview: The golden powers start to fade from Jason.
videos.description: The golden powers start to fade from Jason.

videos.name: Good as Gold
videos.overview: Jason, who is continuing to lose the golden powers, is confronted by Rita and Lord Zedd.
videos.description: Jason, who is continuing to lose the golden powers, is confronted by Rita and Lord Zedd.

videos.name: A Season to Remember
videos.overview: The Rangers, together with their friend Raymond, help Ernie set up for a multicultural holiday banquet, and in the process learn how different cultures celebrate the holidays.
